newsitem.title: CHINA: SHENZHEN B INDEX TOUCHES 10 PCT LIMIT-UP.
newsitem.headline: SHENZHEN B INDEX TOUCHES 10 PCT LIMIT-UP.

text.p: Shenzhen's hard currency B share index hit its 10 percent limit-up level of 151.20 points in early afternoon trading on Thursday, powered by a diversion of foreign funds from the Hong Kong market, brokers said.
"Funds are being diverted from the more expensive Hong Kong stocks to Shenzhen, and newly listed B share firms are leading the way," an analyst at J&A Securities said.
Recently-listed Bengang Steel Plates rose to its 10 percent limit-up level of HK$2.59 on turnover of 19.6 million shares, making it the most heavily traded issue.
